connections.why: Lattes typed dried stains by Landsteiner's groups, building on the stain test Landsteiner and Richter described in 1903.

Essen-Möller's probability of paternity (1938), which turned blood-group evidence from exclusion into a probability, is Bayes' theorem: even prior odds multiplied by the likelihood ratio of the family's blood types.
